retainedEvidence.limitations: Historical portal-proxy evidence; no direct Graph or current authentication/tenant/role proof.

freshObjective: Current-date proxy response shape and authentication drift are unavailable from retained November6 early-UTC observations. One bounded native Home navigation and reload exercises the existing capture, verification, discovery and enrichment loop without inventing API requests.

authority.userGoal: Representative fresh read-only collection; normal sign-in for previously selected account explicitly allowed if needed.

authenticationRecovery: Reuse dedicated Purview cached/WAM session first; normal browser/OS sign-in only for same unambiguous selected account. Stop on consent, account ambiguity, unavailable login/feature or missing roles; never device-code auth.
failureRecovery: Preserve every checkpoint and failed body. No unchanged failed-route/login retry. Require an observed distinct remedy/new reviewed plan for incomplete bodies or unavailable states. No errors or absence imply removal.
